steps.description:
The program should run forever and can only be terminated when the Stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked.

Show that your robot can perform the following with 1 Button:
1. When a Button is not pressed, a buzzer sound will be played continuously.

2. When a Button is pressed and held, no sound will be played.

Hint:
1. Use logic to check for Button press.
2. Use Forever Loop.

The program should run forever and can only be terminated when the Stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked.

Show that your robot can perform the following with 1 Ultrasonic Sensor:

1. When the distance between the sensor and obstacle is below 50cm, a buzzer sound will be played continuously.

Hint:
1. Use Forever Loop.

The program should run forever and can only be terminated when the Stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked.

Show that your robot can make a sound when a Button is pressed and the distance between the sensor and obstacle is below 50cm.

Hint:
1. Use Forever Loop.

The program should run forever and can only be terminated when the stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked.

Show that your robot can make a sound when no Button is pressed and the distance between the sensor and obstacle is above 100cm.

Hint: 
1. Use Forever Loop.

The program should run forever and can only be terminated when the Stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked.

Show that your robot can make a sound when no Button is pressed and the distance between the sensor and obstacle is between 101cm and 150cm (inclusive).

Hint:
1. Use Forever Loop.

The program should run forever and can only be terminated when the Stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked.

Show that your robot can make different beeping sounds depending on the distance between the sensor and the obstacle and whether a Button is pressed or not:
1. When the distance is between 51 cm and 100 cm (inclusive) and the Button is pressed, the robot makes an A4 note 

2. When the distance is between 51 cm and 100 cm (inclusive) and the Button is not pressed, the robot makes a B4 Note
